text:
sam: Heads up — saw token delta wobble on a user repro. Repro steps below.
lee: details?
sam: session id s=eu-central:zz9; start streaming chat; at seq=12 client issues toolcall /summarize -> service returns 202 Accepted and closes without body (async). Client retries toolcall (idempotent) and we end up with two toolcall log entries but console provisional shows duplicate provisional credits then disappears after confirm; billing ledger shows provisional entries with negative TTL evictions.
lee: logs?
sam: paste:
```
2026-03-19T09:14:05Z INFO session=zz9 event=stream.chunk seq=12
2026-03-19T09:14:06Z INFO session=zz9 event=toolcall start id=tc-9
2026-03-19T09:14:06Z INFO session=zz9 toolcall status=202 body_len=0
2026-03-19T09:14:07Z INFO session=zz9 event=toolcall retry id=tc-9
2026-03-19T09:14:08Z INFO session=zz9 event=stream.final
```
maria: does token-attrib tag toolcall by idempotency key? if not we could double-provision.
lee: it uses request id but the retry reuses same id in this case; weird.
billing-bot: ledger trace: provisional: [toolcall:1.5, toolcall:1.5, stream:4.1]; confirmed: [toolcall:1.5, stream:4.1]; TTL eviction removed one provisional after 3s leading console to show provisional<confirmed briefly.
sam: I think the problem is provisional eviction when body_len=0 treats as transient and we don't emit provisional stub until result complete. This makes provisional count non-monotonic and confuses console and alerts.
maria: proposal: attribution should emit provisional immediately on toolcall.start with a flag 'pending_body' and reconcile on final. Also console should surface provisional vs confirmed per-session in timeline + show toolcall HTTP status code.
lee: can we make TTL longer for zero-body toolcalls? or treat 2xx as immediate provisional? both options have tradeoffs.
billing-bot: INF-2124 opened to add per-session provisional delta metric, and a console timeline column for toolcall status and idempotency key.
sam: added minimal curl repro to the ticket. PTAL ken.
ken: I'll take INF-2124. Quick fix: emit provisional on toolcall.start when status >=200 <300, independent of body_len. Will write unit tests and smoke the console.
maria: great. also add a guard to avoid double provisional if same idempotency seen within 500ms.
sam: thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
